title.en: Tale 40 — Everyone Is a Little Right
title.ar: حكاية 40 — كل واحد شوي على حق

book_meta.author: traditional
book_meta.status: public domain — folk material, no known author

sentences.ar: بآخر عمره، سألوا جحا: شو تعلمت؟
sentences.en: At the end of his life, they asked Juha: what did you learn?

sentences.ar: قال: تعلمت إني ما بعرف كتير.
sentences.en: He said: I learned that I do not know much.

sentences.ar: وتعلمت إن اللي بيضحك بيعيش أطول.
sentences.en: And I learned that whoever laughs lives longer.

sentences.ar: وتعلمت إن الحمار بيفهم أكتر من صاحبه.
sentences.en: And I learned that the donkey understands more than its owner.
